events.sourceEvidence: First background lasts 5.2 seconds; following background groups last 4 seconds.

Overlay images are automatically background-removed, appear in turn, and then accumulate on top of one another until their background group ends; each one takes its own layerOrder so the stack does not collide inside a single track.
Dynamic selections limit the supplied Fall Diary SVG to the first 1.2 seconds; this scaffold event spans the template duration for timeline validation.

selectionPolicy.overlayLayout: cutouts cropped to visible alpha bounds and fitted at 0.74, centered slightly below the midpoint, accumulating until the group ends
selectionPolicy.canvasEvidence: The reference is a phone screen recording: its 720x1556 file holds the player UI, and the video area inside it measures about 534x946, i.e. 0.5645, against 9/16 = 0.5625. The template canvas is therefore 9:16, not 1:2.161. At 1080x1920 the supplied 720x1280 background also maps exactly (x1.5) with no crop, where 720x1556 discarded 17.7 percent of its width.

metadata.sourceEvidence: Dynamic groups: one background followed by up to eight automatically cut-out images. The first background lasts 5.2 seconds; each following background lasts 4 seconds. Each cutout keeps its source frame (no alpha-bounds trim) so every portrait photo settles at the same 74 percent width, stays on screen once it appears so later cutouts pile on top, and the stack clears when the next background group starts. Frames sampled every 0.5 seconds across the reference recording show the Fall Diary title present throughout, so it spans the whole template. Autumn leaves come from the source photographs themselves, not from bundled sticker assets.
